name: Pipeline lock
must_be_true: settings card written; spikes S1-S5 pass or fallbacks named; style bible and three style frames approved (G1); H confirmed in writing; hours.csv started
if_not: Slip of one week is allowed (to 2026-11-22). Beyond that drop one runtime tier.

name: Slice rough cut
must_be_true: the slice chapter (C01 = first built, not first in the film) animatic with real photos and temp sound exists; first measured hours in hours.csv
if_not: If no animatic, the 12-20 gate will fail: cut one tier now.

name: Slice approved at the bar
must_be_true: the slice at final quality INCLUDING sound mix, grade, captions and a master played on the venue-class TV at about 3 m; stranger-read passed, if the maker has decided to hold one (Decision 8); otherwise the cold self-read passed (playbook T3); h_slice and h_slice_fin measured over the 100-second slice (chapters.csv slice_s = 100; model rows 173 and 176); material-in-hand share known
if_not: Compare h_slice with T2 in the playbook (production side; finishing at Base until mu_fin is set). Read T2's no-levers column unless two quotes are recorded (its all-levers column includes bought finishing). Record h_slice_fin and mu_fin before reading any verdict. Red: drop to the next shorter scenario. Amber: continue only with the levers adopted.

name: Restart after holidays
must_be_true: H confirmed again; list of chapters with material in hand; cut order reconfirmed
if_not: If H fell by more than 25 percent, recompute and cut now.

name: Mid gate
must_be_true: at least 45 percent of target runtime at status approved or better
if_not: 12 minutes: below 5.4 minutes approved (45 percent of 12), cut the lowest-priority module now (to 9 minutes); a second module is cut only at G-DRAFT if it is not at draft. Other runtimes: the kill-or-cut table in the playbook.

name: All kept modules drafted
must_be_true: 100 percent of kept runtime at draft or better; at least 60 percent rolling-locked; finishing chain rehearsed
if_not: Any module not drafted is replaced by a held-still plus voice-over fallback chapter or cut.

name: PICTURE LOCK
must_be_true: every shot locked=1; timeline hash recorded; git tag picture-lock-2027-02-06
if_not: No exceptions except the unlock rule (written reason, cost in hours, 24-hour wait, factual or dignity errors only). Lunar New Year falls on this date; if observed, lock Fri 5 Feb.

name: Mix v1 and grade v1; strangers screening held if decided
must_be_true: all locked chapters have mix v1 and grade v1; strangers-to-her screening held in week 17 if the maker has decided to hold one (Decision 8); otherwise the cold self-read of the whole film (playbook T3) in week 17
if_not: Fix list only. No new picture.

name: Master verified
must_be_true: ProRes master, access copy, DCP if used; ffprobe and loudness reports; two backups verified; played on venue-class playback
if_not: Buffer week is for fixing, not adding.

name: Playback rehearsal
must_be_true: final file plays end to end on venue-class playback
if_not: Fall back to the access copy on USB.
